notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrect in the Mozio email confirmation specifically for return trip tickets. The return-trip line-item modification mapper and the report-discount application service are the likely fix sites — the discount may not be propagated into the dispatch report for the return segment. Added measurable ACs and derived VCs from the description since original ACs were empty.

notes: Openspec produced empty acceptanceCriteria with only a notes field identifying likely fix sites. I created all ACs from scratch based on the defect description and the technical notes (files listed). ACs cover: (1) core fix for fixed-amount promo on return trips, (2) one-way regression safeguard, (3) percentage-based promo on return trips, (4) consistency between dispatch report and email, (5) over-discount edge case, (6) zero-discount edge case, (7) independent per-segment discount display, (8) webhook/propagation integrity, (9) decimal precision. All ACs describe observable outcomes without referencing implementation details or specific files/functions.
